description: This file contains build configuration and installation instructions for firmware packages related to AMD microcode and graphics drivers, including AMDGPU and Radeon firmware. It defines build rules, installation procedures, and package dependencies for firmware components in the Linux kernel firmware build process.

methods.name: Package/amd64-microcode
methods.description: Defines the firmware package for AMD64 CPU microcode, including its installation process.

methods.name: Package/amdgpu-firmware
methods.description: Defines the firmware package for AMDGPU video driver, including its installation process.

methods.name: Package/radeon-firmware
methods.description: Defines the firmware package for Radeon video driver, including its installation process.
